entries.title: Stop Using Other People's Scoreboard
entries.hook: Feeling behind? You may be using the wrong scoreboard.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: A scoreboard asks who is winning. A map asks where you are and what comes next.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Replace comparison with one honest location.

entries.prompt: Which tool helps you choose the next action?
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime adult woman replacing a sports scoreboard with a simple route map at a cozy desk, relieved adult man nearby, mustard and teal, no readable text.

entries.title: Make the Next Step Visible
entries.hook: Your brain cannot finish a feeling. It can finish an action.

turns.speaker: ethan
turns.text: I need to get my life together.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: That is pressure, not a task. Try a verb, an object, and a time.

turns.speaker: ethan
turns.text: I will update two lines on my résumé at seven thirty.

entries.prompt: What makes a next step visible?
entries.answer: A clear action, object, and time.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime home desk, adult man turns a cloudy thought bubble into one clear task card while an adult woman encourages him, warm daylight, no readable text.

entries.title: Choose Continuity Over Speed
entries.hook: A difficult week does not need to destroy the whole plan.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: Ethan planned five study sessions, but work and family changed the week.

turns.speaker: narrator
turns.text: He reduced the plan to two short sessions and one review.

entries.answer: Regular progress, even at a slower pace.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime adult man calmly simplifying an overloaded weekly planner into three clear blocks, warm home setting, hopeful mood, no readable text.

entries.title: Fact or Summary? Repair the Thought
entries.hook: Everyone is moving forward. Is that a fact or a summary?

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Replace the heavy summary with facts.

turns.speaker: ethan
turns.text: I have not applied for a new role, but I completed a course and led a project.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Now ask what you want and choose one visible step this week.

entries.prompt: What comes before choosing the next step?
entries.answer: Replace the summary with accurate facts.
entries.visualBrief: Bright anime split composition, adult man faces a dark vague cloud on one side and three clear evidence cards on the other, adult woman guides the change, no readable text.
